messages:
Ana P: Quick async bulletin — doing a short samplekit sweep today. What I did: merged CI fixes from yesterday, updated README snippet for the new wheel instructions, and trimmed an old example that referenced deprecated API. Blocker: macOS wheel build still flakes on the CI runners (fails packaging step). Today: triage the flake, try a pinned-build PR, and update the quickstart to avoid the flaky path.

Mike R: Can you paste the failing log? also drop the PR link for the change you merged.

Ana P: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/542 — small docs + CI env tweak. Failing log excerpt below:

```
ERROR Collecting samplekit
  Could not build wheels for samplekit, which is required to install pyproject.toml-based projects
  clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)

FAILED tests/test_package.py::test_build_wheel - subprocess.CalledProcessError: Command '['/opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11/bin/python', '-m', 'build', '--wheel']' returned non-zero exit status 1.
```

Samir K: I saw this exact linker failure on M1 runners earlier this quarter. Usually it's two things: (1) missing system libs on the mac image, (2) pip/setuptools wheel/build incompat. Quick try: pin build to latest build 1.0.0 or bump manylinux tag. I'm happy to open a PR to pin build & setuptools to a known good combo. cc @Jen L for docs wording.

Jen L: Good call. For docs quickstart we can avoid the `pip install .` path that triggers local wheel build and instead recommend `pip install samplekit` from PyPI for the quickstart, or include a prebuilt wheel URL for devs who need local installs. I'll draft a tiny wording change and add a note about mac runner flakiness. Will open a docs PR in ~30m. :memo:

docs-bot: Auto-update: samplekit TOC change detected; staging doc at https://docs.redwood.ai/samples/samplekit (not yet published).

Tina M: Thanks for the heads up — I increased the macOS runner timeout for the samplekit workflow from 10m -> 20m and bumped the retry count to 2. I'll keep an eye on the next two runs and report back.

Mike R: Nice. If Samir's pin fix lands, we should re-run the builds and then promote the wheel to the internal artifact store. Also consider adding a short troubleshooting note to the samplekit README about mac builds.

Ana P: Action items summarized: Samir -> PR to pin build/setuptools; Jen -> docs quickstart change + note; Ana -> cherry-pick the packaging fix if Samir's patch is smaller than my merged change; Tina -> monitor CI and increase timeout (done). Will mark thread resolved once the CI passes and the docs PR is merged. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Mike R: :thumbsup:

Ana P: One tiny follow-up: will anyone be able to sanity-check the README snippet after Jen's PR? I can smoke-test on my M1 laptop later today if needed.

Jen L: I can review and run it on a linux runner this afternoon, then request your M1 run for final sign-off.

Ana P: Perfect — team handoff looks good. Closing updates here, will post if anything blocks the release.
